title: Protocol to establish a lung adenocarcinoma immunotherapy allograft mouse model with FACS and immunofluorescence-based analysis of tumor response
protocol: Culture and maintain HEK293T cell line in a 10 cm petri dish using DMEM supplemented with FBS and penicillin-streptomycin at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Mix the plasmids (9 μg total) with 1 ml of FBS-free DMEM, stand for 5 min at 25°C.
Add 27 μl PEI solution to the plasmid-DMEM mixture and incubate for 15 min at 25°C.
Transfect HEK293T cells by adding the transfection mixture dropwise to the petri dish.
Change the medium within 18 hours post-transfection.
Harvest supernatants containing viral particles 48 hours after changing the medium.
Pellet nonadherent cells and cell debris by centrifugation at 1600 × g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Pass the supernatant through a sterile, 0.45-μM low-protein binding filter.
Transfer approximately 10 mL of lentiviral supernatant to SW-41 ultracentrifuge tubes containing 1.5 mL of 20% sucrose cushion in PBS.
Balance the tubes in the metal bucket by adding media with virus particles until the tubes are at no more than 0.01 g apart and filled until 2 mm from the top.
Concentrate lentiviral particles by centrifugation in an SW-41 rotor at 100,000 × g for 2 hours at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the pellet in 200 μL of 1× HBSS buffer.
Immediately titrate the samples.
Prepare 50 μL aliquots and store them at -80°C.
Clean the biosafety cabinet with 10% bleach followed by 70% EtOH.
Treat used pipettes and tips with 70% EtOH for biohazardous contamination.
Perform the entire process on ice to maintain virus viability.
Store concentrated virus in single-use aliquots at −80°C to avoid freezing and thawing.
Titrate lentivirus using the qPCR Lentivirus Titration Kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Seed 1×10^4 Cre reporter cells with 100 μL DMEM complete medium in a 96-well plate.
Serially dilute the virus 10-fold and replace the medium with 100 μL diluted virus.
Count the number of ZsGreen-positive cell colonies 3 days after changing the medium.
Use the two smallest colony numbers to calculate the titer.
Sedate a KrasLox-STOP-Lox(LSL)-G12D;Trp53flox/flox; ZsGreenflox/flox mouse by intraperitoneal injection of Avertin (female 0.4 mg/g, male 0.45 mg/g of body weight).
Blunt the needle of the catheter by cutting the end with scissors.
Push the catheter completely over the end of the needle.
Confirm the appropriate level of anesthesia by pedal reflex via firm toe pinching.
Fix the mouse on the intubation platform by hooking its upper incisors over a suture and confirm that the chest is vertical underneath the suture.
Place a fiber optic cable between the front legs to illuminate the chest.
Open the mouth of the mouse carefully.
Pull out the tongue using disinfected flat forceps.
Look for the emission of white light to locate the larynx and visualize the epiglottis and arytenoid cartilages.
Slide the catheter into the trachea once the opening is clearly visible.
Remove the needle from the catheter quickly.
Attach a 1-mL syringe containing water to the catheter to confirm proper placement.
Pipette 50 μL of the suspension containing 105–106 TU virus per mouse into the center of the catheter hub.
Aspirate the suspension immediately after pipetting.
Attach a 1-mL syringe and dispense 300 μL of air to ensure consistent distribution within the lungs.
Gently remove the catheter.
Remove the mouse from the intubation platform.
Place the mouse on a heat pad until it recovers from anesthesia.
Ten weeks later, sacrifice the mice.
Isolate the lungs with adenocarcinoma for histological examinations and TDCL establishment.
Culture primary tumor tissue.
Wash fresh lung tumor tissue with PBS containing 1% penicillin and streptomycin.
Mince the tissue into approximately 1-mm diameter pieces with scissors.
Digest minced tumor tissue with 1 mL of 0.25% trypsin–EDTA for 15 min at 37°C.
Remove cell aggregates and tissue fragments with a 70-μm cell strainer.
Collect the cells by centrifugation at 200 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend 10,000 cells with 500 μL RPMI-1640 complete medium.
Seed 500 μL cell suspension in a 24 well culture plate.
Maintain the cells in 500 μL RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with 10% FBS and 100 U/mL penicillin-streptomycin at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere of 5% CO2.
Refresh the tissue culture medium every three days.
Isolate single-cell clones.
Trypsinize subconfluent cell monolayers with 100 μL of 0.05% trypsin–EDTA for 2 minutes at 37°C.
Count the cells.
Dilute cells to 80 cells per 10 mL and seed 100 μL into 96 well plates.
Culture the cells for 14 days.
Pick individual colonies using microscopy.
Expand the cells by seeding TDCL cells in a 10 cm well 24 hours before transplantation at approximately 50% confluency in RPMI-1640 complete medium.
Incubate the cell cultures at 37°C, 5% CO2, and approximately 95% relative humidity.
On the next day, harvest the cells using 1 mL of trypsin-EDTA (0.05% in PBS) at 37°C for 5 minutes per 10-cm plate.
Resuspend the detached cells with 9 mL of RPMI-1640 complete medium.
Count the cells in a hemocytometer.
Transfer the number of cells needed for the experiments into a 50-mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge cells for 5 min at 300 × g.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend cells at a density of 7.5 × 10^6/mL in PBS using a pipette.
Keep cell suspension on ice until transplantation.
Prepare C57BL/6 male mice aged 6–8 weeks.
Mix the cell suspension.
Subcutaneously implant 200 μL of the suspension containing 1.5 × 10^6 cells into the right flank of each mouse.
Measure tumor volume every other day once it reaches 50–100 mm³ (6–8 days).
Calculate tumor volume using the formula V = 0.5 × l × w², where l is length and w is width measured with a Vernier caliper.
Randomly separate tumor-bearing mice into two groups after initial measurements.
Monitor the mean tumor diameter to ensure it does not exceed 20 mm.
Sacrifice mice at the end of the experiment (approximately 25 days).
Isolate tumors by dissection.
Weigh and prepare isolated tumors for in vitro experiments.
Intraperitoneally inject mice with 0.2 mg anti-PD-1 antibody or isotype control every 3 days starting 3 days after inoculation.
Monitor tumor volume every 2–3 days using calipers.
Clean and sterilize surgical instruments, filters, and containers.
Sacrifice the mice.
Dissect tumors and carefully remove skin.
Cut approximately 0.5 g of tumor tissue for lymphocyte isolation.
Transfer tumor tissue to a 50-mL tube containing 1 ml FBS-free DMEM and keep on ice until all tissues are dissected.
Gently cut tumor into 1-mm diameter pieces using scissors within 2 minutes.
Prepare the digestion solution by adding 5 ml PBS to a sterilized bottle, then add 50 μl of 25 mg/ml collagenase IV and 20 μL of 1 mM DNase I.
Mix well by shaking.
Add 5 ml digestion buffer to the tube containing tumor pieces.
Incubate the sample in a shaker at 200 rpm for 1 hour at 37°C.
Perform the following steps very gently and quickly:
Obtain a single-cell suspension.
Add 15 mL PBS to stop the digestion.
Repeatedly pipette the tissue suspension with a dropper.
Pass the tissue suspension through a 200-mesh filter.
Collect the cell suspension.
Lyse blood cells.
Precool the centrifuge to 4°C.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 460 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL ACK lysis buffer and place on ice for 1 min.
Add 10 mL PBS to stop the lysis.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 460 × g for 5 min.
Prepare 40% (v/v) Percoll gradient solution.
Add 6 mL serum free DMEM to a sterilized bottle.
Add 0.4 mL 10 × PBS.
Add 3.6 mL Percoll.
Mix well by swirling.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 10 mL 40% (v/v) Percoll gradient solution.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 550 × g for 35 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant with a dropper.
The resulting cell pellet is enriched for lymphocytes.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL PBS.
Centrifuge at 460 × g for 5 minutes to wash the cells.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellets in 1 mL DMEM containing 3% FBS.
Count the living cells by trypan blue staining.
Transfer equal numbers of living cells (5 × 10^6 is recommended) to 1.5-mL tubes for further flow cytometry analysis.
Prepare culture medium with cytokine stimulation reagents.
Add 0.6 mL DMEM with 10% FBS.
Add 0.6 μL of a 0.5 mg/mL PMA stock solution.
Add 0.6 μL of a 1 mM Ionomycin stock solution.
Add 0.6 μL of Golgi inhibitor stock solution.
Mix well by vortexing.
Centrifuge the lymphocytes at 460 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellets with 600 μL culture medium containing stimulation reagents.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 24-well plate.
Incubate the cells in 5% CO2 at 37°C for 3 hours.
Stain lymphocytes for flow cytometry after allowing them to attach to the bottom of plates.
Resuspend and transfer the cells to 96-well plates.
Centrifuge the 96-well plate at 460 × g for 2 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Transfer the solution twice to collect all the cells from each well in a 96-well plate.
Prepare FACS buffer, which is 0.2% BSA (w/v) in PBS.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the plate at 460 × g for 2 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Prepare the antibody solution.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 50 μL antibody.
Incubate the cells at 25°C for 15 min.
Centrifuge the plate at 460 × g for 2 min.
Discard the antibody.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 200 μL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the plate at 460 × g for 2 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 150 μL fixation/permeabilization solution.
Fix the cells at 4°C for 40 min.
Wash the cells with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge and resuspend the cells in 200 μL FACS buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 50 μL antibody solution.
Incubate the cells at 4°C for 1 h.
Centrifuge the plates at 460 × g for 2 min.
Discard the antibody.
Wash the cells with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge and resuspend the cells in 200 μL FACS buffer.
Pass the cell suspension through a 200-mesh filter.
Analyze with a BD Verse cytometer.
Embed the tissue.
Fix the freshly isolated tumor tissues with 1% paraformaldehyde (PFA) at 4°C for 12 h.
Incubate the tissue with PBS (2 h).
Incubate the tissue with PBS containing 15% sucrose (w/v) (2 h).
Incubate the tissue with PBS containing 30% sucrose (8 h).
Place the dehydrated tissue in an embedding box, add OCT until fully covered and seal the box.
Incubate at 4°C for 12 h.
Snap freeze the tissue on dry ice to create a box-shaped groove.
Freeze the tissue with OCT for 20 min.
Store the frozen tissue at -20°C after OCT fully freezes.
Cut the tissue into 5-μm-thick slices using a cryostat and transfer to a glass slide.
Incubate the slices at 25°C for 2 h to dry.
Store the slices at -20°C.
Add 500 μL PBS to the tissue section.
Let stand and wash for 10 min.
Discard the liquid by vacuum.
Draw lines on both sides of the tissue with a PAP pen.
Wash with PBS again.
Place the slices in a humidified box.
Add a drop of image enhancer (Invitrogen, CAT: I36933).
Incubate at 25°C for 30 min.
Rinse the slices with PBS.
Permeabilize with 0.3% (v/v) Triton X-100 in PBS (PBS-Triton) at 25°C for 30 min.
Prepare the antibody solution; mix well by vortex.
Add 100 μL antibody solution to the slice.
Incubate in a humidified box at 4°C for 12 h.
Discard the antibody and rinse the slices with PBS-Triton four times.
Add a drop of mounting medium, place the coverslip on the slices and seal with nail polish.
Obtain whole tumor images by stitching images collected with a 10 X objective.
Scan the sections by an Olympus FV3000 confocal system with a 60× silicone oil objective to get zoom in images.
Lyse the tumor tissues.
Homogenize and sonicate the tissue in 500 μL RIPA buffer in the presence of 1% (v/v) protease inhibitor cocktail and 2% (v/v) PMSF on ice.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant.
Determine protein concentrations using the Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Heat the protein at 98°C for 5 min with 4× loading buffer.
Separate the sample by SDS-PAGE.
Transfer the sample to PVDF membranes using the Trans-Blot Turbo Transfer System.
Perform immunostaining.
Block the membranes in 5% nonfat milk for 1 hour at 25°C.
Incubate the membranes with primary antibodies diluted in TBS-T supplemented with 3% BSA at 4°C for 12 hours.
Wash the membranes with TBS-T four times.
Incubate the membranes with fluorescent secondary antibodies for 1 hour at 25°C.
Wash the membranes.
Visualize the bands using the Odyssey CLx imaging system.
